QUOTE: Compile time. Set `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` in the user config and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` to your functions. ... Runtime. Set only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes compile-time macros from runtime function pointers but never states that the two are mutually exclusive.
